headline: Fed’s Warsh Says Inflation Poses Less Risk Than a Few Weeks Ago
context: The Federal Reserve chairman, Kevin Warsh, stressed that the central bank would “deliver price stability,” a point he has emphasized repeatedly since taking over in May.

sources.name: The New York Times
